featured_reviews.name: Kajal Chaurasia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined this dance class as a complete beginner, unsure of myself and honestly a little nervous about even stepping onto the floor. But from the very first session, everything changed in the best way possible.

What stood out immediately was how welcoming and encouraging the environment felt. The instructor has an incredible way of making everyone feel comfortable. I never once felt judged or out of place—instead, I felt supported and motivated to try my best.

Each class has been such a joyful experience. The teaching style is clear, patient, and full of energy. The instructor breaks down every move in a way that’s easy to understand, yet still challenges you to improve. I’ve been surprised at how quickly I’ve been able to pick up steps I once thought were impossible.

But beyond just learning dance, this class has become something I genuinely look forward to every time. It’s not just about the choreography—it’s about the confidence I’ve gained, the stress I’ve let go of, and the fun I’ve had along the way. There’s something really special about being in a space where everyone is learning, laughing, and growing together.

Looking back, my best experience hasn’t been just one moment—it’s been the entire journey so far. From my first hesitant steps to now feeling more expressive and confident, this class has truly been amazing. I’m so grateful I took that first step and joined.

I would wholeheartedly recommend this class to anyone, especially beginners like me. It’s more than just a dance class—it’s an experience that lifts you up in every way.

Throughout the years, both Tushna and Khooshoo and team have consistently challenged my daughters to expand their horizons and explore new facets of ballet. Beyond dance technique, the entire ballet teacher’s team including Purva imparted invaluable life lessons to my daughters. They emphasized the importance of discipline, perseverance, and teamwork, instilling in them a strong work ethic and a resilient spirit. Their mentorship extended beyond the studio, shaping my daughters' character and preparing them for success in all aspects of life.

The impact of The School of Classical Ballet and Western Dance on both my daughters' lives goes far beyond their skills as dancers. They have become role models and trusted mentors, providing guidance and support during both the triumphs and the challenges. Their unwavering belief in my daughters' abilities has fostered a sense of self-confidence that will undoubtedly serve them well in their future endeavors.

I am eternally grateful to them for their dedication and unwavering commitment over the past decade. They have not only nurtured the growth of my daughters as dancers but have also left an indelible mark on their hearts and minds. If you are searching for a ballet teacher who is truly exceptional, I wholeheartedly recommend The School of Classical Ballet and Western Dance. Their profound knowledge, passion for ballet, and ability to inspire and mentor students make them a truly remarkable educator. Good luck and God bless!
